title: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarship 2027-2028

organization.name: VLIR-UOS
organization.about: Flemish Interuniversity Council for Development Cooperation.

deadlineText: Programme deadline at KU Leuven; overall VLIR-UOS call closes 28 February 2027
intro: Fully funded master’s scholarship for students from VLIR-UOS partner countries at Flemish universities in Belgium.
description: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect Scholarship 2027-2028 funds a 12 development-relevant English-taught master’s programme at a Flemish university in Belgium (for example the ICP Connect Master of Food Technology at KU Leuven). The grant covers a EUR 1400 per month all-in allowance for living and accommodation, health insurance, installation costs, indirect travel costs and tuition fees, for 12, 24 or 36 months depending on programme length. One economy-class return flight to Belgium at the start and back to the country of residence at the end is included. Applicants must be a national of and reside in a VLIR-UOS partner country in Africa, Asia or Latin America, be no older than 35 on 1 January of the intake year, not have previously received a Belgian government scholarship, not have enrolled in Belgian higher education before 1 January of the intake year, apply for only one ICP Connect Scholarship per year, and meet the programme academic and English language requirements. Applications go through the KU Leuven regular master’s application system by 1 February 2027 at 23:59; a complete master’s application is automatically considered for the scholarship. The overall VLIR-UOS call deadline is 28 February 2027, but individual programme deadlines can be earlier.
